pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the word "Schlafzimmer", which part means "sleep"? (1 mark)
   A. Zimmer
   B. mer
   C. zim
   D. Schlaf

2. What does "das Radio" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. radio
   B. window
   C. shower
   D. table

3. What does articulating a word mean? (1 mark)
   A. Whispering it
   B. Writing it neatly
   C. Saying it as fast as possible
   D. Saying each sound clearly

4. What does "der Saft" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. apple
   B. juice
   C. banana
   D. cabbage or kale

5. What does "gern" mean? (1 mark)
   A. because
   B. never
   C. gladly
   D. often

6. What does "das Knie" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. knee
   B. finger
   C. neck
   D. ear

7. What does "der Kopf" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. arm
   B. toe
   C. head
   D. ear

8. How is the letter A named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ah
   B. eff
   C. yot
   D. pay

9. How is the letter F named in German? (1 mark)
   A. eff
   B. ah
   C. pay
   D. hah

10. How is the letter G named in German? (1 mark)
   A. emm
   B. ay
   C. gay
   D. koo

11. What does "alt" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. small
   B. strong
   C. tall or big
   D. old

12. Which little word goes with the noun "Messer"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. den
   D. der

13. Which little word goes with the noun "Mittagessen"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. der
   D. die

14. What does "der Kohl" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. onion
   B. watermelon
   C. bean
   D. cabbage or kale

15. What does "der Tee" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tea
   B. milk
   C. egg
   D. bean

16. What does "die Hand" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. shoulder
   B. leg
   C. finger
   D. hand

17. What does "duschen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to swim
   B. to help
   C. to have a shower
   D. to cook

18. Which is a safe way to send a greeting message? (1 mark)
   A. Share passwords
   B. Write to strangers
   C. Write only to people you know
   D. Send your address to anyone

19. Which little word goes with the noun "Mutter"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. der
   D. die

20. Which German word or phrase means "Monday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Sonntag
   B. der Montag
   C. der Samstag
   D. der Donnerstag

21. Which little word goes with the noun "Dienstag"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. das
   D. der

22. How many words are in the third line of an Elfchen? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 4
   C. 3
   D. 1

23. What does "Ich möchte singen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. I would like to sing
   B. I am singing
   C. I sang
   D. I like the song

24. Which German word or phrase means "candle"? (1 mark)
   A. das Lied
   B. die Kerze
   C. die Party
   D. der Kuchen

25. Which food group does "die Orange" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. das Obst
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Fleisch

26. Which is the correct spelling for fruit? (1 mark)
   A. Öbst
   B. Obst
   C. Opst
   D. Obts

27. Which German word or phrase means "mouth"? (1 mark)
   A. das Haar
   B. der Zeh
   C. der Bauch
   D. der Mund

28. Which German word or phrase means "finger"? (1 mark)
   A. der Finger
   B. das Bein
   C. das Ohr
   D. der Kopf

29. What does "neblig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. dry
   B. hot
   C. cloudy
   D. foggy

30. Which word is written with a capital letter? (1 mark)
   A. warm
   B. windig
   C. Regen
   D. kalt

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the German words with der, die or das for: lunch, carrot. (2 marks)

32. Write the German words with der, die or das for: fish, living room, rain. (3 marks)

33. Write the German words with der, die or das for: daughter, orange. (2 marks)

34. Write two German sentences about what you would like to do on your birthday. (2 marks)

35. Explain the difference in sound between "ie" and "ei" and give one example day for each. (3 marks)

36. Write the German words with der, die or das for: eye, neck, friend, uncle. (4 marks)

37. Write three healthy foods and two unhealthy foods in German. (3 marks)

38. Explain how a Rückendiktat is done. (3 marks)

39. Write in German: "Who is that? That is my mother." (2 marks)

40. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bathroom, potato, milk. (3 marks)

41. Make a playful food blend from Mango and Milch, and say what it is. (2 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: radio, nose, family. (3 marks)

43. Write the forms of "sein" for ich, du and er. (3 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sky, cooker. (2 marks)

45. Complete with the correct verb form: "Mutter ___ (kochen). Vater ___ (lesen). Der Hund ___ (schlafen)." (3 marks)

46. Write three sentences about today's weather in German. (3 marks)

47. Match the body part to what it does: Auge, Ohr, Nase. (3 marks)

48. Write in German: "Today is Wednesday. Tomorrow is Thursday." (2 marks)

49. Unscramble and write with der or die: STWECHERS. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Schlaf
   Schlaf means sleep and Zimmer means room.

2. A — radio
   das Radio means radio.

3. D — Saying each sound clearly
   Articulation is moving lips, tongue and teeth to say each sound clearly.

4. B — juice
   der Saft means juice.

5. C — gladly
   gern means with pleasure, gladly.

6. A — knee
   das Knie means knee.

7. C — head
   der Kopf means head.

8. A — ah
   In German the letter A is called ah.

9. A — eff
   In German the letter F is called eff.

10. C — gay
   In German the letter G is called gay.

11. D — old
   alt means old.

12. B — das
   It is das Messer, so the little word is das.

13. A — das
   It is das Mittagessen, so the little word is das.

14. D — cabbage or kale
   der Kohl means cabbage or kale.

15. A — tea
   der Tee means tea.

16. D — hand
   die Hand means hand.

17. C — to have a shower
   duschen means to have a shower.

18. C — Write only to people you know
   We stay safe online by writing to people we know.

19. D — die
   It is die Mutter, so the little word is die.

20. B — der Montag
   Monday in German is der Montag.

21. D — der
   It is der Dienstag, so the little word is der.

22. C — 3
   The lines have 1, 2, 3, 4 and 1 words.

23. A — I would like to sing
   möchte means would like to.

24. B — die Kerze
   candle in German is die Kerze.

25. B — das Obst
   die Orange belongs to das Obst.

26. B — Obst
   The word is Obst.

27. D — der Mund
   mouth in German is der Mund.

28. A — der Finger
   finger in German is der Finger.

29. D — foggy
   neblig means foggy.

30. C — Regen
   Regen is a noun. Adjectives are small.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Mittagessen, die Karotte.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Fisch, das Wohnzimmer, der Regen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Tochter, die Orange.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich möchte tanzen. Ich möchte Kuchen essen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: ie sounds like ee (Dienstag); ei sounds like eye (Freitag).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sound and 1 mark for correct examples.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Auge, der Hals, der Freund, der Onkel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Healthy: Obst, Gemüse, Bohnen. Unhealthy: Süßigkeiten, Limonade.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for three healthy foods, 1 mark for two unhealthy foods, 1 mark for correct spelling.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: A partner traces letters on your back; you say the letters aloud and write the word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the steps: tracing, saying, writing.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wer ist das? Das ist meine Mutter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mangmil, a mango and milk drink.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a sensible blend, 1 mark for the explanation.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Radio, die Nase, die Familie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: ich bin, du bist, er ist.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct form.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Himmel, der Herd.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: kocht, liest, schläft.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verb form.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Auge = sehen, Ohr = hören, Nase = riechen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Heute ist Mittwoch. Morgen ist Donnerstag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the article.
